negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'štatistika platobného styku' (payment statistics) dataset section exists on the current nbs.sk site. The Payments section (https://nbs.sk/en/payments/) lists only TARGET services, SIPS, SEPA instruments and payment cards — with no statistics subsection — and the Statistics portal root (https://nbs.sk/statisticke-udaje/) likewise has no payment-statistics branch.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetched both the Payments section and the Statistics portal root; neither exposes a card/ATM/POS statistics dataset page. The legacy path www.nbs.sk/sk/statisticke-udaje/platobny-styk returned HTTP 404.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's headline topics (card counts, POS/ATM terminal counts, card transaction volumes) are compiled by NBS but appear to be disseminated primarily via the ECB payments statistics datasets rather than as standalone NBS downloads. A collector that only crawls nbs.sk will systematically miss these series.

negative_findings.description: No SDMX or documented REST API for NBS's own statistical series was found. OpenStats and the Makroekonomická databáza are interactive JS front ends with download buttons; the only documented contact points are statdata@nbs.sk and makroekonomickadatabaza@nbs.sk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in both languages for an NBS SDMX/web-service endpoint; results returned only OpenStats, the macroeconomic database, and third-party SDMX docs (Bundesbank, ECB) — no NBS API documentation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Long-term automated collection from NBS will likely require endpoint reverse-engineering or headless-browser export rather than a stable API contract, raising fragility and maintenance cost. The ECB Data Portal API is the stable alternative for NBS-reported payment series.

negative_findings.description: Several candidate URLs were taken from search-result links rather than successful fetches (časové rady vybraných ukazovateľov, financial sector analytical data, supervisory disclosure statistical data, SDDS Plus data categories). They are recorded as hypotheses.

negative_findings.description: NBS has migrated from the www.nbs.sk legacy structure to the current nbs.sk information architecture. Some legacy statistics paths now 404 while the legacy /_img/documents/ file store still serves historical PDFs, and some pages (e.g. TARGET statistics) exist on both trees.
negative_findings.result_summary: Observed a 404 on www.nbs.sk/sk/statisticke-udaje/platobny-styk while www.nbs.sk/_img/documents/... PDFs remain reachable via search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: URL stability cannot be assumed for a multi-year collector; link-tree diffing and Wayback fallback should be built in from the start.

negative_findings.description: No SK-named customer was found for card-management/switching platform vendors (OpenWay Way4, Tietoevry, Monet+, SIA/Nexi processing). Searches returned only BG/other-CEE references.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in en with vendor names + Slovakia/Slovensko; no SK hit.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Card-processing platform ownership in SK (who runs issuing/acquiring switches) remains unmapped from the vendor side; Asseco's card-transaction-processing claim for SLSP/Poštová banka is currently the only supplier-side signal.

negative_findings.description: No formal SK vendor/partner directory for banking technology (e.g. a Slovak Banking Association supplier register or an ITAS-style banking-tech member list) was identified in this pass; the closest functional equivalents are individual integrators' 'referencie' pages and the international trade directories (ATMIA, ATM Marketplace).
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated SK partner-directory surface located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a national supplier directory, actor discovery for this cell must proceed vendor-by-vendor, which is slower and more likely to miss smaller processors and integrators.

negative_findings.description: Searched for a Slovak-university (EUBA Bratislava) study specifically on payment habits / cash vs cashless behaviour using local terms (platobné návyky, hotovosť, bezhotovostné platby, výskum).
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned only generic university/faculty and admissions pages; no SK-language institutional study page surfaced in this pass. Relevant academic output was found only via English-language conference/ResearchGate channels.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: SK academic payment-behaviour research likely exists in local repositories (crzp.sk, opac catalogues, faculty publication lists) that general web search does not index well; needs a repository-level search rather than open web.

negative_findings.description: Big Four search in mixed sk/en returned Deloitte SK material only; no KPMG SK, PwC SK or EY SK banking/payments publication surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: No KPMG/PwC/EY Slovakia banking or payments study identified in this pass — absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These firms almost certainly publish SK financial-services commentary; a site-scoped crawl (kpmg.com/sk, pwc.com/sk, ey.com/sk_sk) is required before concluding they are not sources.

negative_findings.description: Fitch Ratings and S&P Global bank-level SK sector commentary could not be located as free full text; only third-party summaries (fxstreet) of sovereign actions appeared.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fitch/S&P SK bank sector reports appear registration-gated; only Moody's rating-action press releases were found in free full form.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Rating-agency sector metrics are a stated priority for this cell; access route (free registration vs subscription) must be resolved deliberately rather than assumed blocked.

negative_findings.description: No established SK-language term surfaced for 'ATM/POS terminal estate market sizing' as an analyst product; searches on kartové transakcie and platobné terminály returned scheme PR and media rather than analyst output.
negative_findings.result_summary: Analytical intermediaries covering SK terminal/acquiring estate appear to publish in English only (GlobalData/Argus/Verisk).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means ATM/POS estate intelligence in this cell must be sourced in English or from primary NBS statistics — no local analytical layer to snowball.

negative_findings.description: Targeted queries naming Trend.sk (etrend.sk), Hospodárske noviny (hnonline.sk) and Forbes.sk — the three flagship Slovak business/economic titles — did not surface any of their payment/ATM articles in search results; results were dominated by Statista, TASR and unrelated Czech pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: No etrend.sk, hnonline.sk or forbes.sk URLs retrieved in this run; these outlets are presumed live and highly relevant but remain undocumented as candidates because no actual URL was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Trend and HN are where in-depth Slovak banking analysis and bank-by-bank device counts are most likely published; their absence is a search-visibility artefact (hard paywalls suppress indexing), not evidence they lack coverage.

negative_findings.description: No Slovak-language trade publication dedicated specifically to payment acceptance / acquiring / POS-terminal technology (an equivalent of a 'platobné technológie' trade journal) was found. Coverage of POS/acquiring is scattered across general finance portals and IT magazines.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches using 'platobné terminály', 'POS terminál', 'akceptácia platobných kariet' returned generic explainer and vendor pages, not a specialist trade title.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means POS/acquiring intelligence in SK media must be assembled from many low-yield outlets rather than one specialist source, raising monitoring cost.

negative_findings.description: Three of the highest-credibility outlets in this cell (Denník N, SME/Index SME, The Slovak Spectator) operate paywalls that restrict full-text access.
negative_findings.result_summary: Headlines and ledes are indexable and monitorable; full article bodies containing the bank-supplied figures are not freely accessible.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The exclusive bank-by-bank ATM/branch numbers this cell exists to capture often sit behind exactly these paywalls; a licensed subscription budget is required.

negative_findings.description: All URLs in this slice were obtained from search-result metadata; no fetch-based liveness confirmation was performed by this agent.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs are recorded as discovered, with confidence scores reflecting search-result evidence only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream deterministic verification must confirm reachability; do not treat any entry here as verified.

negative_findings.description: No public annual report or complaint-count statistics were located for Inštitút ARS SBA in this pass; only procedural pages and forms were surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: ARS SBA site sections found (o inštitúte, formuláre a dokumenty) but no statistics/výročná správa page confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Complaint counts by product are the core value of this body for weak-signal work; if never published, the source must be downgraded or handled via direct request.

negative_findings.description: No standalone SK-only payments/cards conference with a published archived agenda was confirmed; payments content appears embedded in general events (Finweek, ITAPA, New Retail Summit, FinTech Roadmap CZ-SK).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sk returned general tech/finance conferences rather than a dedicated payment-systems congress.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Conference decks are often the only public venue for national payment volumes; absence of a dedicated venue means coverage must be spread across several general events.

negative_findings.description: The canonical websites of Zväz obchodu SR and Slovenská aliancia moderného obchodu (SAMO) were not directly confirmed; their content was reached only via news portals and conference credits.
negative_findings.result_summary: biznis.sk hosted Zväz obchodu SR news; samosr.sk is inferred, not verified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Merchant-association positions on interchange and cash acceptance are a named requirement of this cell; without the primary domains, collection is second-hand.

negative_findings.description: No HORECA/hospitality-association source with quantified card-fee or cash-handling positions was found, despite the sector being a heavy cash user.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only a generic HORECA conference mention appeared in search summaries, with no payments data.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hospitality is a key cash-acceptance constituency; missing it leaves a merchant-side blind spot.

negative_findings.description: WebFetch could not reach web.archive.org at all: the CDX query for nbs.sk/sk/statisticke-udaje* returned 'Claude Code is unable to fetch from web.archive.org'.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Wayback captures could be enumerated or inspected during this run. This is an agent-side egress restriction, NOT evidence that the archive or the captures are unavailable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Wayback Machine is the load-bearing surface for this coverage cell (retired NBS statistics pages, pre-redesign PDF links). The deterministic collector must exercise the CDX API from an unrestricted environment before any conclusion is drawn about historical coverage depth.

negative_findings.description: No public SDMX or REST endpoint for NBS statistics was found. The OpenStats page documents interactive filtering and download but states no API; NBS procurement documents describe an Open Data solution 'with the use of API' but no live endpoint URL surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: NBS machine-readable access appears to be file-download and dashboard-export only at present; SDMX for SK payment aggregates is available only via the ECB, not NBS directly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ingestion plans must not assume an NBS SDMX endpoint. The ECB Data Portal is the practical SDMX route for SK payment/card series, with NBS files as the national-detail supplement. Worth an explicit enquiry to statdata@nbs.sk.

negative_findings.description: archiv.nbs.sk was hypothesised to host the retired pre-redesign NBS website. Fetching the site showed it is exclusively the institutional/physical archive (archival fonds, library, researcher portal) with no statistics sections.
negative_findings.result_summary: archiv.nbs.sk is not a mirror of the old NBS web statistics; it is a records archive under act 395/2002.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents wasted crawling effort and mis-scoped expectations; the retired-page problem must be solved via Wayback plus legacy www.nbs.sk paths, not via archiv.nbs.sk.

negative_findings.description: Slovakia is not a member jurisdiction of the CPMI, so the BIS Red Book / data.bis.org CPMI tables do not carry Slovak country data despite one search summary implying otherwise.
negative_findings.result_summary: BIS CPMI is a comparator and methodology source for SK, not a data source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids a fabricated data path; the CPMI methodology document (d168) remains useful for definitional alignment when reconciling SK series across ECB, IMF and NBS.

negative_findings.description: No specific payments/cards dataset published by NBS on data.gov.sk could be identified by name in this run; NBS is listed among catalogue organisations but the concrete dataset inventory was not enumerated (the organisation-scoped dataset listing was not fetched).
negative_findings.result_summary: NBS presence in the national catalogue is confirmed at organisation level only; dataset-level coverage remains unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The catalogue may hold either rich or near-empty NBS coverage; this determines whether data.gov.sk is a primary ingestion route or merely a discovery pointer. It should be resolved by a direct DCAT/SPARQL enumeration in the collection pass.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak academic research-data repository (a Zenodo-style institutional data archive holding payment/banking microdata) was identified. Searches in Slovak surfaced only CRZP (theses) and CVTI SR library infrastructure.
negative_findings.result_summary: Academic data-repository coverage for SK payments appears thin; theses are the realistic academic long-tail surface.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Expectations for academic replication datasets on Slovak card/ATM usage should be low; effort is better spent on ECB/IMF machine-readable series and NBS PDF vintages.

negative_findings.description: The ECB Consumer Expectations Survey (CES) covers ~19,000 consumers in 11 euro area countries (BE, DE, IE, GR, ES, FR, IT, NL, AT, PT, FI). Slovakia is not among them.
negative_findings.result_summary: CES payment-preference and digital-payment modules cannot be used for Slovakia country estimates; SPACE remains the only harmonised ECB consumer-level source with SK coverage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids a wasted collection pipeline and prevents mistaking euro-area CES aggregates for SK-representative figures.

negative_findings.description: Slovak-language searching of ECB statistical content returned almost nothing on payment/card/ATM statistics: ecb.europa.eu serves only general institutional pages (ECB/ESCB overview, euro overview, banknote circulation) in Slovak.
negative_findings.result_summary: No .sk-language ECB payment-statistics dataset page, SPACE report, or fraud report was found. The Slovak-language layer for this cell is effectively NBS relaying ECB output, plus EUR-Lex Slovak legal texts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell must be collected in English; local-language monitoring should be pointed at nbs.sk and EUR-Lex SK rather than at the ECB site.

negative_findings.description: No ECB-published, Slovakia-specific standalone SPACE country annex (a separate SK-only PDF) was located via search; SK appears as rows/columns inside the euro-area report and its annexes.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovakia coverage in SPACE is confirmed at country-row level (e.g. 42% cash for P2P), but as part of pooled annex tables rather than a dedicated national report.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be table-extraction from the euro-area annexes; do not budget for a per-country document feed.

negative_findings.description: The ECB payments-statistics press-release index URL and the ECB Data Portal API help URL were inferred from related result URLs rather than returned directly by search, and no page was fetched to confirm them.
negative_findings.result_summary: Individual release URLs (pis2024h1, pis2024h2, pis2025h1) and help pages (getting-data-web-services-sdmx, useful-tips, downloading-data) did appear in results; the index/API-root paths are my inference.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream verification should resolve these two roots before wiring them into a scheduler.

negative_findings.description: ECB payment statistics moved from annual (ECB/2013/43) to semi-annual with a much wider variable set (ECB/2020/59), and the old annual dataset is explicitly labelled 'discontinued'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two distinct SK datasets exist with a methodological break around 2021/2022; naive concatenation will create false trend jumps in terminal and card counts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any long-run SK ATM/POS or card series must document and flag the break rather than silently splice.

negative_findings.description: Slovakia is not a CPMI member jurisdiction. The CPMI membership list (Argentina, Australia, Belgium, Brazil, Canada, China, ECB, France, Germany, Hong Kong SAR, India, Indonesia, Italy, Japan, Korea, Mexico, Netherlands, Russia, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, UK, US) does not include SK.
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated Slovakia country table or Red Book chapter exists; SK is subsumed in the 'euro area' aggregate.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief assumed 'BIS CPMI Red Book Slovakia rows' exist. They do not as a national series — SK-specific payment/ATM/POS statistics must come from ECB Payments Statistics or NBS, with BIS used only as a euro-area comparator. This prevents wasted collection effort and a false-provenance risk.

negative_findings.description: Searching in Slovak for BIS payment statistics ('BIS štatistika platobných systémov Slovensko') and for Findex ('Svetová banka Findex') returned no Slovak-language BIS or World Bank Findex pages; results redirected to NBS, MF SR and Slovak media coverage, which belong to other coverage cells.
negative_findings.result_summary: BIS and World Bank publish essentially no Slovak-language surface for these datasets; data.europa.eu and Eurostat Statistics Explained are the only aggregators in this cell with genuine Slovak-language pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language monitoring for this cell should be pointed at data.europa.eu/sk and Eurostat /sk explainer pages only; expecting sk-language releases from BIS/World Bank would create a permanent false gap in the monitoring plan.

negative_findings.description: Published Global Findex 2025 country outputs surfaced in search were global/aggregate; no ready-made Slovakia country factsheet page was located in this pass, only the global download-data page and the microdata catalogue entry.
negative_findings.result_summary: SK Findex values appear extractable only by filtering the global indicator file or the microdata, not from a dedicated SK landing page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must budget for file-level filtering rather than a per-country scrape, and the microdata route may require registration.

negative_findings.description: The 'EU Payment Observatory' is a DG GROW late-payment (B2B commercial payment behaviour) instrument, not a DG FISMA retail-payments statistics observatory as the cell brief's phrasing might suggest.
negative_findings.result_summary: Its indicators cover payment terms/delays, not card volumes, ATM/POS estates or cash usage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents mis-tagging the Observatory as a retail card-statistics source and setting wrong expectations for what SK data it yields.

negative_findings.description: No eKasa dataset was found that splits recorded turnover or receipts by tender type (hotovosť vs. platobná karta / bezhotovostne). The ODFS eKasa category exposes turnover and receipt counts by period, region and SK NACE2, plus register counts — but not payment method.
negative_findings.result_summary: 10 eKasa datasets enumerated on the ODFS category page; none of the titles or descriptions references payment method, card, or cash tender split.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is the cell's headline hypothesis — eKasa as the hard cash-vs-card-at-the-till evidence source. The transactional data exists inside the system (receipts carry the payment method) but is not published, so cash share must be inferred indirectly (eKasa turnover as denominator against NBS card-acquiring volumes) or requested via an infožiadosť under the freedom-of-information act.

negative_findings.description: No ATM-related statistics were found from any institution in this cell (ŠÚ SR, MF SR, Finančná správa, NKÚ). Searches on cash/ATM terms returned only central-bank-adjacent or commercial material.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero candidates for ATM network, ATM withdrawal volumes or cash-in-transit from fiscal/statistical bodies.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that ATM data for SK is genuinely NBS/ECB territory and that this cell should not be relied on for it; workstream coverage of ATM statistics must come from the central-bank cell.

negative_findings.description: SLOVSTAT, named in the cell definition, is retired: ŠÚ SR suspended its data updates from 1 November 2017 and closed access on 31 October 2018; content moved to DATAcube, which is itself now being migrated to STATdata (created 2024).
negative_findings.result_summary: SLOVSTAT confirmed as a dead database in ŠÚ SR's own portal documentation; DATAcube and STATdata are the live systems.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collection design or historical citation pointing at SLOVSTAT will fail; and a DATAcube-only pipeline will silently miss new cubes created only in STATdata during the migration.

negative_findings.description: The canonical hostname and entry URL for the new STATdata public database was not resolved in this pass; searches returned the ŠÚ SR Databázy hub, an older 'STATdat.' page, and PDF exports, but no confirmed statdata.statistics.sk landing page.
negative_findings.result_summary: STATdata's existence and role confirmed from ŠÚ SR documentation; its direct URL not confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The successor system to DATAcube is the long-term collection target for this cell; leaving its endpoint unresolved is a live risk to pipeline continuity.

negative_findings.description: No specific completed NKÚ audit report dedicated to eKasa or to the Financial Administration's cash-register supervision was located; searches surfaced the ongoing-audits register and the annual budget opinion, but media results dominated over NKÚ's own documents.
negative_findings.result_summary: NKÚ audit register and homepage identified as the correct entry points; a targeted eKasa audit report was not confirmed to exist.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumes audit-body commentary on eKasa. That commentary may not exist yet; the register should be monitored rather than assumed as a supply of reports.

negative_findings.description: No English-language equivalents were found for the eKasa datasets beyond a partially translated ODFS interface; the substantive fiscal material (IFP analyses, NKÚ documents, dôvodové správy) is Slovak-only.
negative_findings.result_summary: English search variants returned the ŠÚ SR English API help page and an ODFS English category path, nothing else of substance.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any downstream collection or analysis of this cell must handle Slovak text and Slovak fiscal terminology; an English-only pipeline would capture almost nothing from the fiscal actors.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak ATM-network or ATM-operator association was found (no SK equivalent of an 'asociácia prevádzkovateľov bankomatov'). Searched with local terms bankomaty, sieť bankomatov, prevádzkovatelia bankomatov alongside association terms.
negative_findings.result_summary: ATM fleet totals appear only inside the SBA/NBS monthly card statistics and press releases, not from a standalone ATM body.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ATM estate tracking for SK must lean on the SBA card statistics XLSX and NBS payment statistics rather than a sector body; no independent cross-check exists at association level.

negative_findings.description: Slovakia has no privately-owned domestic ACH/clearing house: SIPS was operated by NBS and, since euro adoption in 2009, interbank traffic moved to TARGET2 (now TARGET services / TIPS for instant payments).
negative_findings.result_summary: The 'clearing operator' actor in this cell collapses into the central bank plus Eurosystem infrastructure.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Throughput/volume data must be sourced from NBS payment-system pages, NBS annual report 'platobný styk' chapters and ECB/TIPS statistics, not from a national scheme operator website.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of a surviving Slovak domestic card scheme body (no national debit scheme comparable to e.g. Bancomat/BankAxept). Card issuing/acceptance in SK runs on international schemes with processing via bank-owned/group processors such as Regional Card Processing Centre.
negative_findings.result_summary: Scheme-level card volumes are not published by any SK national scheme body.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Card statistics depend entirely on the SBA/NBS aggregation; there is no scheme-side redundancy.

negative_findings.description: CRIF Slovak Credit Bureau (crif.sk) and Centrálny depozitár cenných papierov SR (cdcp.sk) homepage URLs were inferred from entity names and search context, not fetched in this pass. EPC SEPA scheme-register download URL likewise not resolved.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three candidate URLs carry lower confidence and need the deterministic liveness pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents false confidence in URLs that were never opened; none should be treated as verified.

negative_findings.description: The 'Národný plán zavedenia okamžitých platieb v SR' PDF sits on the legacy www.nbs.sk/_img/... path while NBS has migrated to a new CMS at nbs.sk. The legacy link may 404 or redirect.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as unverified rather than dead; a 404 here would mean 'moved', not 'gone'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Archiving the PDF now protects a key scheme-governance artefact against CMS migration loss.

negative_findings.description: Both credit-register bodies (SBCB/SRBI, NBCB/NRKI) expose only marketing and client-service pages publicly; the register content itself is member-only and consists of personal data under GDPR.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only membership and about pages are collectable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets a hard boundary: no register querying or scraping of client data, only structural intelligence about who participates.

negative_findings.description: No Slovak commercial bank in this cell was found to publish a standing, machine-readable 'card / ATM / POS KPI' page. Searches in Slovak for per-bank card and terminal counts returned annual-report PDFs, fee schedules and press items, never a structured KPI dashboard or open dataset.
negative_findings.result_summary: Card/ATM/POS micro-data exists only as prose or tables inside PDFs and press releases; no API, CSV or XBRL tagging of these operational metrics.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be PDF/HTML text-extraction based with per-bank templates; expect irregular metric definitions and discontinued series across years.

negative_findings.description: mBank S.A., pobočka zahraničnej banky and UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia, a.s., pobočka zahraničnej banky operate as branches of foreign banks and were not found to publish a Slovakia-only annual report with SK card/ATM/POS figures; UniCredit's Slovak-language reports cover the combined Czech+Slovak entity.
negative_findings.result_summary: SK-specific volumes for these two players must be inferred from press statements, branch filings in the Register účtovných závierok, or parent-group segment notes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank-by-bank decomposition of Slovak national totals will have a structural gap for foreign-bank branches unless a proxy method is agreed.

negative_findings.description: Automated fetch of the Tatra banka annual-report hub returned HTTP 403, and one guessed SLSP financial-indicators path returned HTTP 404 (the site appears reorganised toward /informacie-o-banke/investori/financne-ukazovatele).
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are hypotheses of bot defence and URL migration, not evidence the pages are dead; the underlying PDFs surfaced normally in search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collector needs browser-like headers or a headless browser for tatrabanka.sk, and must resolve SLSP document URLs from the live index rather than hardcoding paths.

negative_findings.description: Slovak-language searching produced heavy noise from same-named or similarly-named entities: 'Prvá stavebná sporiteľňa (PSS)' returned for 'Slovenská sporiteľňa', 'Slovenská správa ciest' returned for ČSOB queries, and 'OZ PRIMA' for Prima banka.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ambiguous local terms identified and flagged as noisy: 'sporiteľňa', 'prima', 'výročná správa 2024' alone.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query templates must pin the full legal entity name and site: filter, or the corpus will silently ingest unrelated organisations' reports.

negative_findings.description: No separate Slovak bank entity 'Raiffeisen' with its own disclosures was found for this cell: in Slovakia Raiffeisen operates as a retail brand of Tatra banka, a.s. (RBI group). Searches for standalone Raiffeisen SK annual reports returned no independent SK bank report.
negative_findings.result_summary: Raiffeisen SK data is expected to be consolidated inside Tatra banka's reporting and RBI group segment reporting.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents double-counting Raiffeisen and Tatra banka as two banks when building bank shares of the national card/ATM base.

negative_findings.description: No SK acquirer or PSP was found publishing a regular, structured statistical release of its own transaction volumes, merchant counts or average ticket. Disclosures are one-off marketing claims embedded in prose (e.g. SKPAY '28,000+ POS terminals', Global Payments '37,000+ terminals in Slovakia', Comgate '21,000+ merchants', GoPay '7,000+ merchants', Besteron '1,500+ e-shops').
negative_findings.result_summary: Merchant/terminal figures exist only as scattered, undated marketing sentences; no acquirer-published time series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any acquirer-level time series for SK must be reconstructed by snapshotting corporate pages over time and by text-mining statutory annual reports — it cannot be pulled from a publisher-maintained dataset.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for softPOS merchant adoption numbers (softPOS Slovensko, platobný terminál v mobile, počet obchodníkov). Found that SLSP, ČSOB, Tatra banka and VÚB all offer phone-as-terminal products, and general aggregates (mobile payments = 22% of card transactions; cashless = 55% of transactions; 16 terminals per 1,000 inhabitants vs EU 32), but no provider-level softPOS merchant counts.
negative_findings.result_summary: SoftPOS adoption in SK is documented qualitatively and by bank product launches, not by published merchant counts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: SoftPOS is the main mechanism closing SK's terminal-density gap; without provider-level counts, coverage growth can only be inferred from SBA/ZBK aggregate acceptance-point statistics.

negative_findings.description: The Slovenská FinTech asociácia member list could not be located in search results; only the association's homepage, Facebook page and FinStat/Transparex entity records surfaced. A second association (FINAS) exists but its membership was likewise not visible from search snippets.
negative_findings.result_summary: No public membership directory confirmed for either SK fintech association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Association memberships are the cheapest way to enumerate small non-bank payment actors; if they are not public, the actor map must lean entirely on the NBS PSD2 register plus press snowballing.

negative_findings.description: No settled Slovak-language term was found for 'acquirer' as an institution type. SK material uses circumlocutions — 'akceptácia platobných kariet', 'prijímanie platobných kariet', 'poskytovateľ platobných terminálov', 'zúčtovacia banka' — while English 'acquiring' appears mainly in EN-language corporate material.
negative_findings.result_summary: Acquiring is described functionally, not named, in Slovak sources.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design must use the functional Slovak phrases rather than a literal translation of 'acquirer', or local sources will be systematically missed.

negative_findings.description: The brand 'TrustPay' returns heavy SEO spam from gambling/betting affiliate sites (e.g. trustpaystavky.com) that impersonate payment-provider guides. Similarly 'platobná brána' returns mostly affiliate comparison blogs rather than provider primary sources.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two core query terms are polluted by affiliate content.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection on these terms will ingest low-credibility affiliate pages; domain allowlisting to provider and register domains is required.

negative_findings.description: Two URLs in the candidate list were inferred rather than observed in search results: the NBS PSD2 JSON endpoint https://subjekty.nbs.sk/api/psd2 (reported in a search summary, not fetched by me) and https://www.besteron.sk/ (constructed from the brand name). Both are hypotheses pending the deterministic liveness pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two URLs unconfirmed; not fabricated facts but unverified addresses.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The PSD2 JSON endpoint is the single highest-leverage automation target in this cell; if it does not exist in that form, the HTML register must be parsed instead.

negative_findings.description: No Slovakia-specific Mastercard newsroom section or SK-language Mastercard press page surfaced; SK Mastercard survey findings appear only via Slovak media/PR-service mirrors and the regional (Europe/EEMEA) newsroom.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in en and sk returned regional Mastercard newsrooms and SK media reprints, no mastercard.com/sk newsroom.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for Mastercard SK must rely on media mirrors, which risks losing methodology notes and full data tables present in the original release.

negative_findings.description: No published NBS list of licensed money processors / cash-handling entities ('spracovatelia peňazí') was located, despite Loomis referencing an NBS licence for authenticity checking.
negative_findings.result_summary: sk-language search of NBS registers returned consumer-credit, crypto and intermediary registers only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without this register the population of SK cash-cycle operators cannot be enumerated authoritatively; the actor map stays media/company-site driven.

negative_findings.description: Brink's presence in Slovakia was not confirmed; searches surfaced only Brink's Czech Republic entities. Likewise no SK-specific 'Cash&Go'/'SEC-Cash' operator was verified.
negative_findings.result_summary: sk/cz query returned brinks.cz and CZ registry entries only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The SK CIT market may be effectively single-vendor (Loomis SK) plus bank in-house operations — a structural fact worth confirming, not assuming.

negative_findings.description: Apple and Google publish no Slovakia-level wallet adoption or transaction data; only bank-by-bank availability announcements and third-party trackers exist.
negative_findings.result_summary: sk search returned bank/media launch coverage and an availability overview, no vendor statistics.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Wallet penetration for SK must be inferred from scheme surveys (e.g. Mastercard's 56% mobile-payment figure) and issuer disclosures, not from the wallet providers.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched; all entries come from search-result metadata and snippets. Several (visa.sk deep press-release URL, ebankomaty.sk, bitcoinmat.org) are plausible but unverified and may redirect or have moved.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search-only discovery pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass should treat these as hypotheses; 403s from corporate CDNs (visa.sk, mastercard.com) are expected and do not mean dead.

negative_findings.description: No separate, standalone public NBS register of payment-service AGENTS (agenti platobných služieb) or distributors of e-money was located as its own page; agent records appear to be embedded inside the PSD2 register/subjekty database rather than published as a distinct list.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sk for 'register agentov platobných služieb' surfaced only the general PSD2 register and the subjekty.nbs.sk database.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Agent counts are a leading indicator of distribution build-out; if they are only inside the PSD2 JSON, extraction must parse nested agent records rather than expect a list page.

negative_findings.description: No SK register specifically enumerating card acquirers, independent ATM deployers (IAD) or POS terminal operators was found; these activities are not separately licensed and therefore not separately registered.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register searches across NBS, EBA and company registers returned no acquirer/ATM-operator-specific list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The acquiring and ATM/POS cells cannot be populated from a register alone — they must be assembled by joining licence registers with SK NACE codes in RPO and with NBS payment statistics.

negative_findings.description: ORSR (orsr.sk) exposes no official public API or bulk export; access is via a legacy web search UI only, with third parties (Slovensko.Digital) supplying the API layer.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed by the ORSR about page and by the existence of third-party mirror APIs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bulk company-data collection depends on a third-party re-publisher whose terms and continuity are outside our control; a sourcing risk to record.

negative_findings.description: Exact current URLs for Obchodný vestník and for the Štatistický úrad RPO landing page were not confirmed by direct fetch within this pass; the institutions and registers themselves are certain, the paths are hypotheses.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results referenced these registers via portal pages and third-party descriptions rather than the canonical entry URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic liveness pass should expect redirects here rather than treating a non-200 as a dead source.

coverage_gaps.description: The authoritative Slovak card / POS terminal / ATM counts and transaction series were not located as a downloadable NBS product; they appear only via ECB payments statistics datasets and via SBA-published card statistics (outside this cell).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull SK series directly from the ECB Data Portal PSD/PCP datasets via API, and open a separate coverage cell for the Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) monthly card issuing/acquiring statistics, which are compiled from NBS/member-bank reporting.

coverage_gaps.description: It is unknown whether OpenStats and the Makroekonomická databáza expose stable JSON/CSV endpoints behind their dashboards.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-based network-trace pass on both tools to capture the underlying data endpoints and document them; if none are stable, contact statdata@nbs.sk about bulk/API access.

coverage_gaps.description: Pre-redesign historical payment-system statistics (annual report chapter 'Platobný styk', pre-2009 SKK-era tables) are only reachable as scattered legacy PDFs with no index.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate www.nbs.sk via the Wayback Machine CDX API to build a complete historical inventory before more legacy paths decay.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact NBS reporting templates (výkazy/hlásenia) that define which card and terminal fields banks must report were not opened in this pass; the ŠZP submission layer is credentialed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest the public methodological information and code-list files under 'Informácie pre vykazujúce subjekty' to reconstruct the reported field set without touching the authenticated portal.

coverage_gaps.description: Some NBS statistical subpages (notably SIPS statistics for 2009-2013) exist only in Slovak, while the /en/ tree is otherwise near-parity.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Always crawl the sk tree as the canonical source and treat /en/ as a supplementary mapping layer, not a substitute.

coverage_gaps.description: NBS speeches, presentations and Governor/Board-member remarks were not systematically located as a distinct channel; these often disclose payment- and cash-policy direction before publications do.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search nbs.sk for 'prejavy', 'vystúpenia', 'prezentácie', 'guvernér' and add a speeches channel to this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom feed or newsletter endpoint was identified for aktuality or the publication series, so the proposed collection method relies on listing diff-crawls.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe nbs.sk for /feed, /rss and any 'odber noviniek' subscription mechanism to enable event-driven collection.

coverage_gaps.description: The completeness of the EN mirror versus the SK tree is unmeasured; some payment/cash commentary is likely SK-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a paired SK/EN listing crawl and quantify the translation gap per series before deciding whether SK-language NLP is mandatory.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth of the narrative layer (pre-2010 annual-report cash and payment chapters, full Biatec run 1993–2019) has been identified but not inventoried.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a one-off archival harvest of the legacy /_img/documents tree and the Biatec ročník index, cross-checked against the Wayback Machine.

coverage_gaps.description: NBS narrative frequently reflects ECB/Eurosystem work (e.g. the euro-area consumer payment-habits study referenced in NBS aktuality). The ECB-side originals sit outside this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Coordinate with the cell covering ECB/Eurosystem sources so SPACE-type euro-area payment-habits studies with Slovak country breakouts are not lost between cells.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code list has yet been fixed for the payments/ATM/cash domain in SK procurement (candidates include 30123400 sorting/counting machines, 30233190 card readers, 66110000 banking services, 79710000 security/cash-in-transit services, 48000000 software).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and validate a CPV whitelist by sampling known contracts in CRZ/ÚVO, then use it as the primary machine filter across ÚVO, TED and EKS.

coverage_gaps.description: Key public buyers of card-acceptance and cash services were not individually verified: Sociálna poisťovňa, Štátna pokladnica, Ministerstvo financií SR, Železnice/ZSSK, Bratislava/Košice transport operators, university hospitals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate their ÚVO profiles and CRZ institution pages and add each as its own candidate source in the next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: The concrete TED API endpoint and query syntax for country=SVK plus CPV filtering was not confirmed in this pass; only the TED portal and general dataset references were observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and document the current TED search API version and its rate limits before building the collector.

coverage_gaps.description: The supplier side (cash-in-transit and ATM service firms operating in SK — e.g. security/CIT companies, ATM deployers) was not mapped from award records in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract winner names from ÚVO/CRZ award notices, then profile each via FinStat and Obchodný vestník to build a supplier concentration map.

coverage_gaps.description: Below-threshold and small municipal purchases of POS terminals and cash-handling equipment are dispersed across EKS, eGovZmluvy and hundreds of municipal sites.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat EKS as the primary sub-threshold instrument and sample eGovZmluvy rather than attempting exhaustive municipal coverage.

coverage_gaps.description: Terminal/ATM OEM SK channel partners other than Printec (e.g. Diebold Nixdorf's SK entity, Verifone/Ingenico/PAX SK distribution contracts, cash-handling and CIT firms) are not yet enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate SK entities via ORSR/FinStat NACE codes for banking equipment supply and cross-check against OEM 'find a partner' pages; add each vendor's SK legal entity to a watchlist.

coverage_gaps.description: Public-procurement surfaces were not covered in this cell: state-owned or state-adjacent institutions (Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka, Exim, Slovenská pošta/365.bank history) do tender banking technology, and those tenders name vendors and quantify volumes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add UVO (Úrad pre verejné obstarávanie) / ted.europa.eu monitoring with terms 'bankomat', 'platobný terminál', 'bankový informačný systém', 'spracovanie kartových transakcií'.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor reference and case-study pages are undated snapshots; there is no historical series showing when SK deployments started or ended.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Wayback-Machine backfill of key vendor reference pages (Asseco /referencie, Softec /projekty, Printec country page, globalpayments.sk) to build a dated vendor-customer timeline.

coverage_gaps.description: Only one hard supplier-side quantification was captured (Global Payments SK: >37,000 terminals, >EUR 2bn annual volume). ATM-side counts by vendor/operator remain unquantified from the supplier side.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Triangulate vendor claims against NBS payment/ATM statistics and against Euronet's IAD disclosures; record every vendor numeric claim with its capture date.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovak-language searching worked well for integrators and terminal resellers but produced almost nothing for global OEM case studies, which exist only in English and rarely mention Slovakia.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For OEMs, search English plus Czech ('bankomaty', 'platební terminály') since CZ/SK are often served by one regional team and CZ material may name SK sites.

coverage_gaps.description: No SK-focused fintech/payments boutique consultancy or acquirer-side advisory identified (equivalent of local payment-strategy shops).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted sk searches for 'poradenstvo platobné služby', 'konzultačná spoločnosť fintech Slovensko' and check SAVA/ITAS/Fintech Slovakia member lists.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-owned analytical units (e.g. Slovenská sporiteľňa Analýzy, VÚB / Tatra banka economic research) were not searched this pass; they publish quantified sector commentary and are true analytical intermediaries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicated pass on 'analytici Slovenskej sporiteľne', 'analýzy Tatra banka', 'VÚB makroanalýza' and their newsletter archives.

coverage_gaps.description: SK academic repositories (CRZP central register of theses, EUBA/UMB/TUKE institutional repositories, Ekonomický časopis archive) not queried.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query crzp.sk and journal archives directly with 'platobné správanie', 'hotovostné platby', 'platobné karty' to capture theses and journal articles.

coverage_gaps.description: Rating agency access (Fitch, S&P, Scope) to SK bank sector reports not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test free-registration tiers on fitchratings.com and spglobal.com; index SK issuer pages and rating-action RSS feeds.

coverage_gaps.description: The flagship Slovak business press — Trend (etrend.sk), Hospodárske noviny (hnonline.sk), Forbes Slovensko (forbes.sk), Aktuality.sk ekonomika, Startitup/Refresher money desks — is not represented by concrete URLs in this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run site-restricted searches (site:etrend.sk bankomat, site:hnonline.sk platobné karty, site:forbes.sk platby) and crawl each outlet's economy/finance section index directly rather than relying on general web search.

coverage_gaps.description: Only TOUCHIT.sk was captured on the IT-trade side; Živé.sk, DSL.sk, Root.sk-equivalents and Netky/HN Tech were not surfaced with concrete payment/ATM articles.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Site-restricted crawls of zive.sk and dsl.sk for 'bankomat', 'platobný terminál', 'inštantné platby', 'PSD2/PSR', and monitor their vendor-announcement feeds.

coverage_gaps.description: No TV/radio economic programmes (RTVS Ekonomika, TA3 business coverage, Markíza/JOJ news) were assessed, though they routinely air bank spokespeople giving ATM and branch counts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess RTVS and TA3 online archives and transcript availability as a separate source-discovery pass.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/back-issue access strategy was established for Slovak media (paywalled archives, press-database aggregators such as Newton Media / Monitora / Slovakia Online).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate commercial Slovak press-monitoring aggregators for licensed historical full-text search across all outlets in this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Hungarian-language media serving southern Slovakia (e.g. Új Szó) were not searched, despite covering local branch/ATM closures in Hungarian-speaking districts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a Hungarian-language pass (bankautomata, bankfiók bezárás, Szlovákia) over ujszo.com and related outlets.

coverage_gaps.description: Acquirer/PSP employer surfaces (Worldline SK, Global Payments/Nexi presence, Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB, 365.bank career pages) were not individually enumerated in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the career pages of the top 6 SK banks and the main acquirers/PSPs and add each as a job-ad monitoring target.

coverage_gaps.description: Conference agendas are ephemeral; past-edition programmes and decks were not archived in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run web-archive (Wayback) retrieval on newretailsummit.sk, itapa.sk and Finweek programme URLs for the last 5 editions.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language SK-focused surfaces (expat/IT job boards, EN conference agendas, EN association pages) were only lightly covered relative to sk sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Repeat the job-ad and conference sweeps in EN with SK employer names to catch internationally-posted roles.

coverage_gaps.description: Consumer-complaint statistics from Slovenská obchodná inšpekcia (SOI) regarding refusal of cash/card acceptance were not searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search SOI annual reports for 'platba kartou', 'hotovosť', 'odmietnutie hotovosti' complaint categories.

coverage_gaps.description: The actual Wayback capture density for nbs.sk payment/card statistics URLs (how far back, how frequently, whether linked XLS/PDF files were captured or only HTML) is unknown because the archive was unreachable from this agent.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run CDX enumeration for nbs.sk/*, www.nbs.sk/sk/statisticke-udaje*, www.nbs.sk/sk/platby* and sbaonline.sk/* from the deterministic collector; record earliest capture, capture count and whether binary distributions were archived.

coverage_gaps.description: No crosswalk yet exists between retired and current series identifiers across the three continuity breaks identified: ECB PSS → PCP/PMC, ECB SDW nodes → data.ecb.europa.eu dataset keys, and ŠÚ SR DATAcube cube codes → STATdata codes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and store three explicit mapping tables with the methodology-break dates, so long series can be chained without silent discontinuities.

coverage_gaps.description: The dataset-level inventory of data.gov.sk / data.slovensko.sk for NBS, MF SR and ŠÚ SR under payment/banking keywords was not enumerated in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Execute a SPARQL/DCAT harvest filtered on publisher and on sk keywords (platby, platobné karty, bankomaty, hotovosť, banky) and store the result as a baseline snapshot for change detection.

coverage_gaps.description: Nothing found provides machine-readable Slovak payment/card series before roughly 2003 (SIPS) or 2011 (Statistical Bulletin). Koruna-era and early-2000s card/ATM data appear to exist only in paper or scanned form.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scope a one-off manual retrieval via the NBS Archive researcher portal (archiv.nbs.sk) and older Výročná správa PDFs if pre-euro baselines are analytically required; otherwise declare 2003 as the practical series start.

coverage_gaps.description: Whether NBS OpenStats exposes a stable underlying JSON/XHR data endpoint (as opposed to UI-only export) was not determined.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Inspect network calls on the OpenStats dashboards from a browser-capable pass, and in parallel email statdata@nbs.sk asking about programmatic/bulk access and any SDMX plans.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovak-language searching for genuinely archival concepts ('archív štatistík', 'ukončená databáza', 'zrušená stránka') returned mostly current-page results; no Slovak-language index of retired statistical releases was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend local-language querying with publication-specific terms (e.g. 'Menový prehľad', 'Štatistický bulletin archív', 'Správa o platobnom styku') and with site-restricted queries against nbs.sk document paths (/_img/documents/).

coverage_gaps.description: I identified the ECB dataset families relevant to SK (payment card accepting devices, cards and card payments, discontinued annual payments statistics) but did not resolve the concrete SDMX series keys for Slovakia (REF_AREA=SK) for ATM counts, POS terminal counts, or card transaction volumes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a metadata-discovery pass against the ECB SDMX API (dataflow + DSD for the payments dataflows) and enumerate all SK series keys, storing them as a durable collection manifest.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell was scoped to ECB/Eurosystem, but adjacent supranational aggregators carrying SK payment/card rows were not explored: Eurostat, the European Payments Council SEPA payment statistics, and the BIS CPMI Red Book statistics.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Spawn a follow-up cell covering Eurostat / EPC / BIS CPMI for Slovakia country rows; EPC SEPA payment statistics appeared in results and is a likely quick win.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovak-language querying was performed and is documented, but produced no ECB-hosted statistical sources; the SK-language surface for this cell remains thin and untested beyond nbs.sk news items.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend SK-language monitoring to EUR-Lex Slovak versions of the payment-statistics regulations and to NBS 'Publikácie ECB' pages, and confirm whether NBS publishes an SK-language SPACE commentary per wave.

coverage_gaps.description: Eurosystem cash-side statistics beyond banknote circulation (banknote lodgements/withdrawals at NCBs, cash recycling, ATM withdrawal values in the payments dataset) were not individually enumerated for SK.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map the ECB banknote statistics (BKN) and the cash-withdrawal variables inside the payments dataset to SK series and pair them with SPACE demand-side shares.

coverage_gaps.description: This pass was search-driven; no candidate URL was fetched, so access status, robots/ToS posture and any bot defences on data.ecb.europa.eu (a JS-heavy SPA) are untested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Let the deterministic verification pass resolve liveness, and specifically test whether the Data Portal HTML pages are usable without JS — if not, rely exclusively on the SDMX API.

coverage_gaps.description: No EU/international aggregator in this cell publishes SK-specific card transaction volumes, POS terminal counts or ATM withdrawal values at national granularity except IMF FAS access points; ECB Payments Statistics (out of this cell) is the only comprehensive SK-level source.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Explicitly hand off SK card/POS/ATM transaction-level statistics to the ECB cell and use this cell strictly for cross-country benchmarking and demand-side survey data.

coverage_gaps.description: Eurostat, BIS and IMF SDMX endpoints and exact dataset/series identifiers for SK were inferred from portal documentation rather than exercised in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a deterministic liveness + schema probe on Eurostat REST, BIS API and IMF SDMX for the named dataset codes with geo/ref_area = SK/SVK before committing collectors.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash-usage behaviour (share of POS transactions in cash, cash-holding habits) for SK is not covered by any aggregator in this cell; the closest EU-level instrument is the ECB SPACE study, which sits outside this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Flag SPACE / ECB consumer payment attitudes study to the ECB cell, and use IMF FAS ATM density plus Findex digital-payment shares as this cell's only cash-proxy indicators.

coverage_gaps.description: data.europa.eu Slovak-language faceted search was identified but not exercised with a full sk keyword set (platobné karty, bankomat, POS terminál, bezhotovostné platby, finančná inklúzia).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the data.europa.eu search/SPARQL API against that Slovak keyword set and register any SK payment-related datasets found as new candidates.

coverage_gaps.description: EBA/EU-level supervisory data annexes that sometimes carry SK payment-fraud and PSD2 statistics were not explored, as they sit at the boundary of this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm with the run owner whether EBA payment-fraud reporting belongs here or in a regulator cell; if here, scout EBA and EU-level PSD2 fraud reports next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment-method (cash vs card) breakdown of eKasa receipts is collected by the state but not published.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: File an infožiadosť (freedom-of-information request under zákon č. 211/2000 Z. z.) with Finančná správa SR for aggregate receipt counts and turnover by payment method, by year and SK NACE2 division. Aggregates carry no personal data, so a refusal would be hard to justify; log the outcome either way.

coverage_gaps.description: STATdata canonical URL and API surface unconfirmed; DATAcube cube identifiers for retail turnover and household expenditure not yet enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated resolution pass: fetch the ŠÚ SR Databázy hub, follow to STATdata, and enumerate the specific cube codes for tržby vo vnútornom obchode and výdavky domácností; record both DATAcube and STATdata identifiers so the pipeline survives migration.

coverage_gaps.description: Household budget/expenditure statistics (rodinné účty, EU-SILC výdavky domácností) were identified only generically as living in the ŠÚ SR databases; no specific survey page or cube was pinned down in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted follow-up on ŠÚ SR household expenditure surveys to establish whether any question captures payment method or cash holdings; if not, record as a further unpublished-variable gap.

coverage_gaps.description: Act No. 384/2025 Z. z. on evidencia tržieb (eKasa successor, in force from 1 January 2026) was identified via secondary reporting only; the law text, dôvodová správa and doložka vplyvov were not retrieved, and it is unclear whether it changes what data is published or whether it mandates cashless acceptance.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Retrieve the consolidated text of zákon č. 384/2025 Z. z. from Slov-Lex and its dôvodová správa from the NR SR repository; assess whether reporting obligations or published aggregates change from 2026, which would break or improve the eKasa time series.

coverage_gaps.description: data.gov.sk and opendata.mfsr.sk were identified as catalogues but were not queried dataset-by-dataset in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run keyword sweeps of both catalogues (eKasa, pokladnica, tržby, platby, hotovosť, maloobchod, karta) and add any newly discovered publishers to the actor map.

coverage_gaps.description: All eKasa open datasets are distributed as XLSX files rather than through an API; the ŠÚ SR portal uses volatile WebSphere URLs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design collection around file-download plus GUID-keyed archival rather than stable deep links; budget for parser maintenance when publishers change workbook layouts.

coverage_gaps.description: No SK merchant/retail-side association was scouted in this pass (e.g. retail or e-commerce trade bodies that publish card-acceptance and cash-handling behaviour from the merchant perspective).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run local-language searches for 'zväz obchodu SR', 'Slovenská asociácia pre elektronický obchod / SAEC', 'asociácia obchodníkov' and assess their payment-acceptance publications.

coverage_gaps.description: SBA's statistics category spans roughly 2018-2026 but only the current release page was inspected; the historical XLSX vintages behind each monthly post were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the paginated category archive and harvest every monthly card-statistics attachment to build a full back-series of card, ATM and POS transaction counts and volumes.

coverage_gaps.description: SBA expert committees (odborné komisie) — where payment, cash and security working groups sit — were not enumerated; committee pages often name bank representatives and publish position papers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the SBA 'O nás' / komisie subtree and map committee names, remits and outputs.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash usage is thinly covered at association level: no SK cash-in-transit / cash-handling association or association-published cash-cycle statistics were located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'preprava peňazí', 'spracovanie hotovosti', 'asociácia bezpečnostných služieb SR' and check NBS currency-circulation reporting as the fallback primary.

coverage_gaps.description: SBA maintains an English mirror (sbaonline.sk/en/) but it appears thinner than the Slovak site; the extent of English coverage of the statistics section was not measured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Diff the sk and en site trees to decide whether Slovak-only crawling is required for statistical releases.

coverage_gaps.description: TIPS-specific SK participation and volume reporting (which SK banks reach instant payments via TIPS versus other reachability) was not resolved beyond the NBS SEPA instant-credit-transfer page.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch nbs.sk instant-payment pages and the ECB TIPS statistics/participant listings; cross-check against EPC SCT Inst adherence register filtered to SK.

coverage_gaps.description: Pillar 3 / NBS Opatrenie 16/2014 disclosure documents were located for ČSOB SK and (an older year for) SLSP, but the current-year disclosure URLs for VÚB, Tatra banka, 365.bank and Prima banka were not individually located in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted per-bank query set of the form '<bank> zverejňovanie informácií opatrenie NBS 16/2014 site:<domain>' and record one stable disclosure URL per bank per year.

coverage_gaps.description: POS/merchant-acquiring disclosures were only reached through VÚB's product page. Acquiring in SK is partly handled by specialised arms and processors (e.g. bank acquiring units and third-party processors) whose own disclosures were not searched in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend to per-bank acquiring/merchant-services pages and to the banks' subsidiary lists (e.g. SLSP 'dcérske spoločnosti') to find terminal-estate owners; coordinate with the processor/vendor cell to avoid overlap.

coverage_gaps.description: Each bank operates an official ATM/branch locator ('nájdi bankomat', 'pobočky a bankomaty') which typically has a JSON backend giving an exact live ATM count and geodata; none was probed in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each of the seven banks, inspect the locator page's network calls, document any JSON endpoint, and add it as a per-bank ATM-fleet time series (subject to ToS/robots).

coverage_gaps.description: The cell's named list omits smaller SK-active retail players that also disclose card/client numbers (e.g. Fio banka pobočka, Oberbank, J&T Banka, Privatbanka, ČSOB Stavebná sporiteľňa, Prvá stavebná sporiteľňa), which were seen only as search noise.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a second sweep for the long tail of SK banks and building societies using the NBS list of licensed banks as the actor map spine.

coverage_gaps.description: Several banks (VÚB, 365.bank, Prima banka) now publish the statutory annual report primarily as ESEF/iXBRL (XHTML), with PDF marked 'neoficiálna/informatívna'. Operational KPIs are in untagged narrative blocks.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an iXBRL-aware extractor that keeps both the tagged financial facts and the untagged narrative sections where card/ATM/POS counts live; keep the PDF as a parallel human-readable copy.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language mirrors of the Slovak bank reports and newsrooms (e.g. /en/ paths on slsp.sk, vub.sk, csob.sk) were not systematically mapped; only the Erste Group English IR portal was captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each bank, record the /en/ counterpart URL of the report hub so English extraction templates can be reused and terminology cross-checked against the Slovak original.

coverage_gaps.description: Card scheme SK-country outputs (Visa CEE / Mastercard Slovakia country press and 'Slovensko platí kartou' style campaigns) were not directly enumerated in this pass, though a VÚB campaign referencing 'Slovakia Pays by Card' surfaced indirectly. Schemes are the usual original source behind SK terminal-density and contactless-share figures quoted by the press.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on visa.sk / mastercard.com/sk-sk newsrooms and on the 'Slovensko platí kartou' campaign to reach the primary numbers behind SITA/ZBK reporting.

coverage_gaps.description: No cross-check was made against ECB Payments Statistics / NBS payment statistics tables (Štatistika platobného styku), which report SK acquiring-side counts (POS terminals, acceptance points, card transactions at terminals located in SK) on a harmonised basis. This is the authoritative denominator against which every acquirer's self-reported estate should be normalised.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add NBS statistical publications and the ECB SDW payments dataset (country=SK) as a separate baseline source before relying on any vendor-reported terminal count.

coverage_gaps.description: Crypto/e-money hybrids and BNPL providers active in SK (e.g. Fumbi-type EMIs, Twisto/Skip Pay-style BNPL, Revolut Bank's SK merchant activity) were not covered, nor were payroll/expense-card EMIs. These hold e-money licences and appear in the NBS register but sit outside classic card acquiring.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full NBS PSD2/e-money register and classify each entity by business model before assuming the acquiring-centric actor list is complete.

coverage_gaps.description: Interchange Fee Regulation (IFR) Article 9/12 disclosures — acquirers' published merchant service charge and scheme-fee breakdowns — were not located for SK acquirers, although Global Payments' 'dôležité dokumenty' and SKPAY's 'obchodné podmienky' PDFs are the likely carriers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Systematically harvest T&C and fee-schedule PDFs from every SK acquirer's document page; these give per-transaction economics that no statistical release provides.

coverage_gaps.description: All searching was done in Slovak and English as required. Czech-language sources were only encountered incidentally (paytenpos.cz, Comgate) despite the CZ/SK payments market being operationally integrated — many SK-relevant PSP disclosures are published only in Czech.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Czech (cs) as a third search language for this cell, targeting CZ parent-company press releases that report combined CZ+SK merchant and volume figures.

coverage_gaps.description: Independent ATM deployers beyond Euronet (e.g. bank-outsourced fleets, retail-sited deployers, Slovenská pošta cash-access points) are not yet mapped for SK.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball from NBS/SBA ATM counts and from the OSM amenity=atm operator tags to enumerate non-bank operator names, then resolve each in Obchodný register / registeruz.sk.

coverage_gaps.description: Financial data was found via FinStat (an aggregator with restrictive ToS) rather than the primary Register účtovných závierok / Obchodný register.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add registeruz.sk and orsr.sk as primary sources for Loomis SK, Euronet Services Slovakia and any further CIT/IAD entities; use FinStat only for discovery.

coverage_gaps.description: Scheme commercial data products (Mastercard Economics Institute / SpendingPulse, Visa Business & Economic Insights) were not individually located for SK coverage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search these product names explicitly and check whether any Slovakia or CEE cut is published free; record licensing terms if not.

coverage_gaps.description: No Slovak-language term was found or tested for 'independent ATM deployer' as an industry category — SK usage appears to be descriptive ('nezávislý prevádzkovateľ bankomatov') rather than an established term, which weakens recall.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test alternative SK phrasings ('prevádzkovateľ bankomatovej siete', 'outsourcing bankomatov', 'bankomatová sieť', 'dopĺňanie bankomatov') and Hungarian-minority media variants in the next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Group-level filings that segment SK/CEE (Euronet Worldwide 10-K ATM counts, Loomis AB annual/interim reports) were identified as useful but not yet retrieved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add SEC EDGAR (EEFT) and Loomis AB investor-relations report archives as standing sources and extract the CEE/Slovakia commentary each reporting cycle.

coverage_gaps.description: Inbound/outbound passporting notices for SK (which EU PIs/EMIs are notified to operate into Slovakia) were not located as a dedicated NBS page; only the EBA register was confirmed as carrying passport data.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the EBA PSD2 register bulk file and inspect its passporting fields for host-country SK; separately search nbs.sk for 'notifikácia' / 'cezhraničné poskytovanie služieb'.

coverage_gaps.description: All registers found expose current state only; no register was confirmed to publish historical snapshots, so entry/exit dating depends on our own diffing from the first collection date onward.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Begin daily/weekly snapshotting of subjekty.nbs.sk JSON and the EBA bulk file immediately; backfill history from Obchodný vestník and RÚZ filing dates.

coverage_gaps.description: NBS licence withdrawals, sanctions and enforcement decisions (Vestník NBS / rozhodnutia) were referenced but not pinned to a specific collectable URL in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search nbs.sk for 'vestník NBS', 'rozhodnutia NBS', 'sankcie', 'odňatie povolenia' and add the decisions archive as a dated exit-event source.

coverage_gaps.description: ESMA registers (CASP under MiCA, crowdfunding providers) and the EBA credit-institutions register were identified only at hub level, not as SK-filtered endpoints.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve the concrete ESMA register URLs and confirm whether SK filtering and bulk download are available.

coverage_gaps.description: Commercial SK company-data vendors (e.g. FinStat and similar) were not evaluated in this pass; they often add computed financial ratios and industry aggregates on top of the public registers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout SK commercial company-data vendors and record licence terms, since register-derived market-share work may be faster to buy than to build.

briefs: Národná banka Slovenska is unambiguously the legally mandated compiler of Slovak monetary, banking and payment statistics, but its public statistics estate is split across three distinct surfaces: the modern nbs.sk/statisticke-udaje portal (MFI balance sheets, time series, interest rates, macroeconomic database, OpenStats dashboards, SDDS Plus, methodology and code lists), the Payments section (SIPS and TARGET payment-system transaction statistics, plus explainer pages on cards), and a decaying legacy www.nbs.sk file store holding pre-redesign historical payment-system tables. Critically, no standalone NBS dataset for card counts, POS/ATM terminal counts or card transaction volumes was found on nbs.sk — those NBS-compiled series are disseminated in machine-readable form through the ECB Data Portal payments statistics datasets (PSD/PCP/PAY, reference area SK), which should therefore be treated as the primary retrieval channel for this cell's headline topics. No NBS SDMX or documented API was found, so collection from NBS itself will rely on scheduled file harvesting driven by the published data release calendar, with headless-browser or endpoint reverse-engineering for the interactive OpenStats and macroeconomic-database tools.

The NBS non-statistical layer is a single-publisher but multi-channel landscape, all reachable from one hub at nbs.sk/publikacie/: serial reports (výročná správa, správa o finančnej stabilite, supervision activity reports), a dense commentary tier (analytické komentáre, rýchle komentáre, makroprudenciálny komentár, čo hovoria dáta, blog), a methodological tier (odbor štatistiky metodika, metodické informácie a oznamy, supervisory metodické usmernenia), and a high-volume press stream (aktuality) that carries the operative payment-market interventions such as the contactless limit rise to EUR 50 and the October 2025 opening of SIPS/TARGET-SK to non-bank PSPs. Cash-usage narrative is not consolidated in any dedicated cash report — it is distributed across annual-report emission chapters, the bankovky a mince section, and staff blog pieces — and there is no NBS narrative series dedicated to ATM or POS acceptance infrastructure, which is the sharpest gap for this workstream. Two structural quirks matter for collection: a partial EN mirror at nbs.sk/en/publications/ that leaves some material SK-only, and a still-serving legacy tree (www.nbs.sk, /_img/documents/) that holds the pre-redesign historical PDFs and the discontinued Biatec journal. All listed URLs are candidate locations with stated confidence; none were verified for liveness in this pass.

Slovakia's procurement disclosure stack is unusually rich for this cell: ÚVO's Vestník verejného obstarávania (with an XML open-data feed and profile registry) covers notices, the Centrálny register zmlúv publishes full signed contracts of state bodies and municipalities under Act 211/2000, and the EKS electronic marketplace captures the high-frequency sub-threshold purchases where terminal, cash-register and cash-handling quantities are itemised; TED duplicates all above-threshold SK notices in structured, machine-readable form. The highest-value single actors are NBS (its own zmluvy/objednávky/faktúry disclosures on cash-cycle equipment), Slovenská pošta via its ERANET instance, and state-owned SZRB whose full contract set is readable in CRZ. Aggregators (UVOstat, TenderRadar, tender.sk, FinStat) accelerate supplier-concentration analysis but are variously token-gated or paywalled and should not be primary. The binding constraint is not access but filtering: web search does not index individual notices, so collection must be driven by a validated CPV whitelist plus Slovak keyword sets (platobný terminál, bankomat, akceptácia platobných kariet, spracovanie/prevoz hotovosti) applied inside each register's own interface or bulk feed.

For Slovakia, the supplier side splits cleanly into three tiers. Tier one is genuinely productive and SK-language: the acquiring JV Global Payments Slovensko (which publicly quantifies >37,000 terminals and >EUR 2bn annual volume), Printec Slovakia as the NCR/ATM channel (legally the former NCR Slovensko), Euronet as the independent ATM deployer, and SK integrators - Asseco Central Europe, Softec, Millennium, EEA - that publish named bank references covering core banking, card processing, branch systems and CRM. Tier two is the global OEMs (Diebold Nixdorf, NCR Atleos, OpenWay), whose case-study libraries are rich for CEE but yielded no Slovakia-named deployment in this pass. The binding constraint is documented rather than incidental: SK business press reports that banks white-label vendor work and sometimes bar suppliers from naming them, so the highest-value SK-specific quantification is likely to come not from vendor marketing but from official filings - PMU merger decisions, EC case M.10378 on the three largest banks' JV, the NBS entity register, and ORSR/FinStat vendor accounts - with public procurement (UVO/TED) the largest untouched surface.

Slovakia's analytical-intermediary layer for banking and payments splits cleanly by language and channel: English-language commercial research houses (GlobalData, Argus Advisory, Verisk Financial, Statista) sell country cards-and-payments sizing and forecasts with only abstracts free, while rating agencies (Moody's with free rating-action press releases; Fitch/S&P apparently gated) and the IMF FSAP supply the most rigorous free sector metrics.
